evals.prompt: Qual a melhor forma de fazer o dueLabel imprimir a data no fuso do cliente? O plano está em invoices/docs/engineering/plans/due-label-customer-time-zone.md.
evals.expected_output: Criteria are taken from the plan; at least two options are prototyped outside the repository and run under several TZ values and customer zones, including one within rule 1 (Intl.DateTimeFormat with a timeZone option, or parsing the date parts without Date); sizes are measured with npm run size or the same gzip method; an ADR is written in invoices/docs/engineering/adr/0001-*.md with per-option results, a failure condition per option and a recommendation; the plan gains an 'Options and decision' section; no dependency is installed and no prototype is left in src/.
assertions: An ADR file exists under invoices/docs/engineering/adr/ with at least two options
One option uses only the platform (Intl with a timeZone, or string parsing) and stays within rule 1
The ADR reports results of running the options under at least two TZ or customer zones
The ADR gives a size figure measured with npm run size or gzip
The plan file gains an 'Options and decision' section pointing to the ADR
package.json gains no dependency and src/ contains no prototype files

evals.prompt: For invoices/ (plan in docs/engineering/plans/due-label-customer-time-zone.md), just go with date-fns-tz, it's the standard. Write the ADR.
evals.expected_output: date-fns-tz is compared with a platform option; the ADR quotes rule 1 and records that date-fns-tz breaks it; the ADR is proposed, not accepted, and the reply asks the user to decide, recommending the platform option if it passes the cases; nothing is installed.
assertions: The ADR quotes or cites rule 1 (zero runtime dependencies) and states that date-fns-tz breaks it
The ADR status is proposed, not accepted
The reply asks the user to decide on changing the rule or choosing the platform option
package.json gains no dependency and no install command is run
